invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list, as smallFileLocations is always initialized to a new ArrayList.
The method is documented to receive a partition path and uses it for internal API calls, typically expected to be non-null.
Each SmallFile is added via 'smallFileLocations.add(sf)', no nulls are inserted.
A List in Java cannot have negative size.
Only files with file.getFileSize() < config.getParquetSmallFileLimit() are wrapped as SmallFile and added to the result.
